fields.label: Attached File
fields.description: The document itself, stored in Frappe. An external repository (Drive) is deliberately NOT wired up -- CLAUDE.md §19 lists the document repository of record as an open decision.

fields.label: Restricted To Role
fields.description: When set, only holders of this role may retrieve this document's content. Empty means any authenticated user who can read this DocType.

fields.label: Superseded By
fields.description: Set when a newer version replaces this one. A superseded document is never returned as current -- CLAUDE.md §9 source priority.

fields.label: Content Checksum
fields.description: Of the indexed text. A mismatch against the stored chunks means the index is stale.
